clips.title: The story
paras: Off the Barrens coast, Shipment of Boots lies in a Southsea encampment south of Ratchet. Drizzlik sent the crate from Booty Bay for Gazlowe's trade network, but the pirates seized it before it reached port.

Gazlowe arranged for Drizzlik, a clothing merchant in Booty Bay, to send boots to Ratchet. Southsea Freebooters patrolling the Merchant Coast ambushed the ship and carried the crates to their beach encampments south of the harbor. They scattered the stolen goods among their tents and shanties, and the shipment remains there, far from Ratchet's docks.
